content:
Maria (PM): quick sync — we need to firm up Q4 perf priorities. customers (NovaApps + FinOS) escalated tail latency for 512-token gen; they want p99 < 200ms on hosted for small LLMs. also Dedicated customers pushing throughput for batch scoring.
Alex (EngRuntime): +1. do we attempt kernel/attention optim first or quantization? both touch perf budget differently.
Dan (ML Infra): quantified tradeoff: int8 gives ~1.7x throughput but increases p99 variance on cold cache. KV cache helps tail a lot.
Priya (SRE): operational ask: any change can't regress cold start p99 beyond 10%. we need rollout canaries per region.
Jose (PerfEng): proposal: three-track plan
- track A: kernel micro-optimizations (fused kernels, mem reuse)
- track B: quantization (per-layer int8 + calibration harness)
- track C: KV cache improvements (prefix cache TTL, sharding)
Alex (EngRuntime): sounds right. estimate: A=6 wks, B=8 wks, C=4 wks (parallelizable).
Maria (PM): customers want an MVP by mid-quarter. we may need to cut scope. prioritization decision here.
Dan (ML Infra): suggestion: deliver C (KV) + targeted kernel hotpath first; defer full quant until next sprint. KV gives biggest p99 wins for repeated prefixes.
Priya (SRE): agree. KV rollout has fewer correctness concerns. still need feature flag + rollout plan.
Jose (PerfEng): acceptance criteria draft:
- Hosted: p99 latency for 512 tokens <= 200ms on small models (measured over 72h) OR 30% p99 reduction vs baseline
- Throughput: 1.5x median tokens/s for dedicated workloads (measured on our tooling)
- No >10% increase in cold-start p99 vs baseline
Maria (PM): ok. who owns metrics + dashboard?
Alex (EngRuntime): Jose + Dan can own bench harness, Priya owns SLO alerts and canary playbook.
Maria (PM): timeline proposal:
- Week 1–3: KV cache TTL/eviction + prefix index + canary infra
- Week 2–6: kernel hotpath (fused attn for 512) benching
- Week 4–8: quantization PoC on staging (no prod rollout)
Jose (PerfEng): sample config for KV canary:
```
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  ttl_ms: 30000
  shard_count: 8
  prefetch_prefixes: 5
```
Alex (EngRuntime): quick note: need to update runtime to expose `kv.hit_rate` + `kv.size_bytes` metrics.
Priya (SRE): will add alerts: kv_hit_rate < 0.6 for 10m => rollback candidate.
Maria (PM): decision: ship KV improvements + kernel hotpath as Q4 alpha. quant stays experimental.
Dan (ML Infra): action items assigned: Jose -> bench harness and baseline by Fri; Alex -> PR for metrics + runtime flags; Priya -> canary playbook
Jose (PerfEng): will post bench link when done. cc @maria
deploy-bot: Perf bench job queued: #9876 — ETA ~3h
Alex (EngRuntime): :thumbsup: will update the roadmap doc and product board.
Maria (PM): thanks all. we'll review progress in Tues sync and adjust if customers push quant.
Priya (SRE): noted. tagging FinOS for heads-up? @maria want me to ping them?
Maria (PM): yes, short note outlining tradeoffs and expected alpha timeline. keep it high level.
Alex (EngRuntime): ok sending a draft to #customer-comm in 30m
Jose (PerfEng): end of thread — posting initial bench results soon.
